description: Structured factual data on major Egyptian tourist landmarks, designed for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. Each landmark folder contains info.json (core facts), faq.json (15-20 tourist Q&A pairs), and image_metadata.json (descriptions of recommended images, no generated images included).

image_metadata_json_fields: images (array of image_id, title, description, suggested_shot_type, time_of_day, tags, recommended_use)

data_currency_disclaimer: Ticket prices, opening hours, and booking procedures for Egyptian archaeological sites change periodically (set by Egypt's Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities / Supreme Council of Antiquities). Figures in this knowledge base reflect the most recent publicly available information as of July 2026 and should be re-verified against official sources (e.g. egymonuments.com) before being used for real-time booking decisions. Historical, architectural, and cultural facts are stable and not subject to this caveat.
